title: ServiceResponsiveness
description: ISO 25011 quality archetype — Responsiveness viability dimension. Degree to which the IT service provider reacts to user requests in a timely fashion. Sub-characteristics: Timeliness, Reactiveness. Rootless archetype — unique to service quality, no product-quality equivalent. Source: ISO/IEC TS 25011:2017 §7.6.

timeliness.description: Classification of response time commitment for the IT service. BEST_EFFORT = no SLA on response time. STANDARD = defined response windows. PRIORITY = expedited response. IMMEDIATE = real-time response required.

reactiveness.description: Degree to which the IT service provider anticipates and acts on user needs. PASSIVE = responds only to explicit requests. STANDARD = responds with awareness of context. PROACTIVE = anticipates needs and initiates action.
